answer: Each epoch every identity must submit freshly reasoned, non-duplicate work: the ledger fingerprints each answer's content and rejects near-copies before any reward or attestation posts. A clone farm cannot press one answer across a thousand keys; each must independently cross the tundra of original cognition that round, so sybils cannot let one template wander across many accounts or cultivate standing in a shared garden of recycled text. Attacker cost stays linear: 1000 fakes need 1000 distinct chains of reasoning every epoch (real compute plus novel analysis per head), nothing to amortize.
